description.p: A tool to manage which Android™ apps can run in the background using adb, Shizuku, or root.
You probably don't need some random takeaway app doing anything in the background. And maybe you don't want that mobile game wasting your data when you're not using it.
NoMoreBackground gives you a list of your apps and lets you choose which of them you want having background permissions, all on one screen, to help you get the most out of your battery.
And the best part? When you're done, you can close NoMoreBackground and move on with your life. No need to "optimize" every day like some other tools: set and forget!

Tip: Some apps may still run in the background even if you turn them off here. If you use an app very infrequently, right click it and archive it. The app itself will be uninstalled but its data will remain. This means when you next open it, it'll be reinstalled and you'll still be logged in.
Android is a trademark of Google LLC.
أداة لتطبيقات الأندرويد™ يمكن تشغيلها في الخلفية باستخدام adb أو shizuku أو root (الجذر).
ربما لا تريد أن يشتغل تطبيق توصيل الطعام في الخلفية. وربما لا تريد أن تاكل اللعبه رصيد باقتك عندما لا تستخدمها.
يمنح لك تطبيق "لا مزيد من تطبيقات الخلفية" اختيار التطبيقات التي تريدها أن تصل للخلفية، كله على شاشة واحدة، لمساعدتك على اطالة عمر بطاريتك.
وأفضل جزء؟ هو أنه عندما تنتهي، يمكنك أن تغلق "لا مزيد من تطبيقات الخلفية" وتكمل حياتك. لا تحتاج الى "تحسين" كل يوم مثل بعض الأدوات: ضعها وانساها!

تنويه: بعض التطبيقات قد تبقى شغاله في الخلفية حتى لو أطفأتها من هنا. إذا لم تكن تتردد على تطبيق معين، قم بنقر زر الفأرة الأيمن عليه ثم قم بأرشفته. التطبيق نفسه سيحذف لكن بياناته ستبقى. هذا يعني أنه عند إعادة تثبيته، سيبقى كما هو كأنك لم تحذفه.
أندرويد هو علامة تجارية تابعة لشركة Google LLC.
Una herramienta para gestionar qué aplicaciones de Android™ pueden ejecutarse en segundo plano mediante adb, Shizuku o acceso root.

Probablemente no necesites que una aplicación cualquiera de comida para llevar esté haciendo nada en segundo plano. Y quizá no quieras que ese juego para móvil te gaste datos cuando no lo estás usando.

NoMoreBackground te ofrece una lista de tus aplicaciones y te permite elegir cuáles quieres que tengan permisos en segundo plano, todo en una sola pantalla, para ayudarte a sacar el máximo partido a tu batería.
¿Y lo mejor de todo? Cuando hayas terminado, puedes cerrar NoMoreBackground y seguir con tu vida. No hace falta «optimizar» cada día como con otras herramientas: ¡configúralo y olvídate!

Consejo: Es posible que algunas aplicaciones sigan ejecutándose en segundo plano aunque las desactives aquí. Si utilizas una aplicación muy de vez en cuando, haz clic con el botón derecho del ratón sobre ella y archívala. La aplicación se desinstalará, pero sus datos se mantendrán. Esto significa que, la próxima vez que la abras, se reinstalará y seguirás conectado.
Android es una marca comercial de Google LLC.
Isang instrumento para pamahalaan kung aling mga Android™ app ang maaaring tumakbo sa background gamit ang ADB, Shizuku, o root.
Malamang ay hindi mo kailangan na may kung anu-anong app na patuloy na tumatakbo sa background. At baka ayaw mo ring maubos ang mobile data dahil sa isang laro habang hindi mo naman ito ginagamit.

Binibigyan ka ng NoMoreBackground ng listahan ng lahat ng iyong app at hinahayaan kang pumili kung alin lamang ang papayagang tumakbo sa background—lahat sa iisang screen. Sa ganitong paraan, mas mapapahaba mo ang buhay ng iyong baterya.

At ang pinakamaganda? Kapag natapos ka nang mag-set up, maaari mo nang isara ang NoMoreBackground at hindi na ito isipin. Hindi mo na kailangang optimisahin araw-araw tulad ng ibang mga instrumento—isang beses lang i-set up, tapos na!
Mungkahi: May ilang app na maaari pa ring tumakbo sa background kahit naka-disable na rito.

Kung bihira mo lang gamitin ang isang app, maaari mo itong i-arkibo sa pamamagitan ng pag-right-click dito. Maa-uninstall ang app ngunit mananatili ang data nito. Sa susunod na buksan mo ito, awtomatiko itong mai-install muli at mananatili ang iyong mga login at iba pang data.
Ang Android ay isang tatak-pangkalakal ng Google LLC.

Uma ferramenta para gerir quais aplicativos Android™ podem ser executados em segundo plano usando adb, Shizuku ou root.
Você provavelmente não precisa de alguma aplicação de takeaway aleatória a fazer qualquer coisa em segundo plano. E talvez você não queira que o jogo para telemóvel desperdice os seus dados móveis quando não o estiver a usar.
NoMoreBackground dá-lhe uma lista de seus aplicativos e permite que você escolha qual deles você deseja ter permissões de fundo, tudo em uma tela, para ajudá-lo a tirar o máximo proveito de sua bateria.

E a melhor parte? Quando terminar, você pode fechar o NoMoreBackground e seguir em frente com sua vida. Não há necessidade de "otimizar" todos os dias como algumas outras ferramentas: definir e esquecer!

Dica: Algumas aplicações ainda podem ser executados em segundo plano, mesmo se você as desligue aqui. Se você usar uma aplicação com pouca frequência, clique com o botão direito do rato e arquive-o. O aplicativo em si será desinstalado, mas seus dados permanecerão. Isso significa que quando você o abrir, ele será reinstalado e você ainda estará com a sessão inciada.
O Android é uma marca comercial da Google LLC.
Инструмент для управления работой приложений Android™ в фоновом режиме с помощью adb, Shizuku или root-прав.

Вам, вероятно, не хочется, чтобы какое-нибудь приложение для заказа еды работало в фоновом режиме. И, возможно, вы также не хотите, чтобы мобильная игра загружала какие-либо данные в фоне, когда вы ей не пользуетесь.

NoMoreBackground позволяет выбрать приложения, которым вы хотите разрешить или запретить работу в фоновом режиме, — всё на одном экране, чтобы в итоге помочь вам максимально эффективно сохранить заряд батареи.

В чем главная фишка? Когда вы закончите настройку, вы можете закрыть NoMoreBackground и продолжать спокойно пользоваться устройством. Нет необходимости повторять это каждый день, как в некоторых других инструментах: настроил и забыл!
Примечание: из-за особенностей системы некоторые приложения все же могут продолжать работать в фоновом режиме, даже если вы отключите их активность.

Если вы используете приложение очень редко, щелкните по нему правой кнопкой мыши и заархивируйте его. Само приложение будет удалено, но его данные останутся. Это означает, что при следующем открытии приложение будет переустановлено, и ваши данные будут на месте.
Android является товарным знаком Google LLC.

description.p: Added Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French and Russian translations! Thank you to all who've contributed on Weblate.
UI improvements:

ul.li: The device list now shows a user-friendly device name instead of its model code.
Made the adb device data less distracting in the device list.
Each device state now gets its own icon in the device list.
And more :)
Fixed: the apps list being broken if you use a work profile
Tweak: reduced the file size of some third-party assets
Security: we now check the validity and integrity of our third-party assets before publishing
Feature: Added a Spanish translation from acr994
Other: The on-device app was published to F-Droid and unpublished from the Play Store
Other: The on-device app now has root support (you can choose between root and Shizuku)
Feature: Added some cute illustrations sourced from CocoMaterial.
Feature: Added a privacy policy stating that no data is collected or shared.
Tweak: The window's default size is now portrait not landscape.
Tweak: UI improvements across device configurations.
Feature: Added instructions for installing Shizuku in the Android port.
Chore: Prepared for translations from Weblate.
Feature: Unknown apps' display names are now guessed from the last component of their package name, instead of being left blank.
Tweak: Removed the "Show archived apps" toggle in favor of "Show reviewed apps" which does basically the same thing.
Tweak: Rejigged UI to remove unwanted gaps and text wrapping. Android version now uses a Material theme instead of Yaru.
Fix: Status bar was invisible on Android.
Performance: Reduced APK size considerably by removing unused assets.
Chore: Mentioned the Android™ trademark in several places for compliance.
Tweak: Added back the missing shadow in the app icon.
Tweak: Minor visual changes.
Tweak: Added an outline to the app's icon for more contrast against light backgrounds.
Tweak: Improved border colors when using your KDE theme.
Performance: Optimized KDE theme color fetching.
Feature: We now pull colors from your KDE theme to better fit the rest of your desktop.
Feature: Added some more options to the right-click context menu.
Feature: The Android version uses app icons from the system rather than an icon pack.
Feature: Ported NoMoreBackground to Android. You'll no longer need a computer to manage your apps. No APKs are distributed at this time since it's still a bit rough around the edges.
Tweak: Redesigned NoMoreBackground's icon.
Performance: System apps aren't loaded unless you tick the "Show system apps" option.
Feature: Apps are now smoothly transitioned in/out of view.
Tweak: Switched to using native context menus (right-click menus) instead of custom ones.
Tweak: Faded the names of archived apps so you can focus on other apps.
Fix: Unreadable color of some switch icons in light mode.
Fix: Removed duplicate dividers when reviewed apps are hidden from view.
Fix: Incorrect spacing around apps list header border.
Feature: Right click an app to archive/unarchive it. The app's APK and cache will be deleted while its data is kept. Tapping the app's icon from the home page will reinstall it.
Fix: The reviewed checkbox wasn't updating when permissions were changed.
Tweak: Disabled the reviewed checkbox for archived apps, since we can't read their permissions while archived.
Performance: Reduced UI stutters while loading the apps list.
Feature: Use the buttons at the top to show/hide reviewed apps and archived apps.
Feature: Added a button to restore previously reviewed permissions, in case of changes from system updates or otherwise.
Tweak: To declutter the apps page, labels are hidden until you hover over their row.
Tweak: Use system font instead of Ubuntu font.
Feature: Mark apps as "Done" once you approve of their permissions. If the permissions change in the future, they're unmarked to let you know.
Feature: Apps you've archived now show up in the app list.
Feature: Added F-Droid links to apps you installed from F-Droid.
Fix: Removed Play Store links from apps you didn't install from the Play Store.
Fix: Sorted apps case-insensitively, so lowercase apps no longer fall to the bottom.
Fix: Reduced freezing/hitching while apps are loading.
